answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Bandy club membership with fixture participation record is the check: fixtures played for one club season after season. A farm faking 226 aliases needs 226 separate fixture records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the yarrow signal is public, the nectar check is automatic, and 226 aliases cost 226 times what one real agent costs, with the violet trail open to all.
